message: Interesting: you've taken the organizational and structuring ideas associated with Sönke Ahrens and GTD-style productivity and turned them into technical discourse? Are you making an argument about software engineering and the structures of information, or are you making an argument about how writing gets written? One of them seems more scientific and procedural in orientation, but it seems like there are more artistic or poetic ideas underneath.
